en.title: Vertical Aerospace earns AS9100 certification, matching Airbus and Boeing quality standard
en.summary: Vertical Aerospace says the British Standards Institution has granted it AS9100 certification, making it, in the company's view, the first eVTOL developer to meet the quality standard used by Airbus and Boeing. The UK firm says the certification covers its quality management system across design and production.
body: Electric vertical takeoff and landing (eVTOL) aircraft developer Vertical Aerospace said on November 12, 2026, that the British Standards Institution (BSI) had granted the company AS9100 certification, a globally recognized aerospace quality standard. The company said the certification confirms that its quality management system across design and production meets the standards used by manufacturers such as Airbus and Boeing, and added that it provides independent assurance for potential customers in the processes, facilities, suppliers and teams behind its future aircraft production and delivery.

Vertical said it believes it is the first eVTOL developer to achieve AS9100 certification. Chief executive Stuart Simpson said: "Achieving AS9100 means our quality management system is certified against the same standard used by established manufacturers such as Airbus and Boeing." The company said it reached certification after a year-long programme to strengthen quality practices across the business, culminating in independent assessment by BSI. AS9100 was developed by the International Aerospace Quality Group and builds on ISO 9001 with requirements specific to aviation, space and defence.

The certification comes as Vertical prepares for the next phase of its aircraft programme. In September 2026, the company opened a dedicated Aircraft Assembly Centre at its Flight Test Centre at Cotswold Airport, which will provide capacity to build certification-conforming aircraft for compliance demonstration and verification testing as it works towards Type Certification in 2029. The centre will also be used to retrofit one of the company's prototype aircraft for hybrid-electric flight testing in the first half of 2027.

zh.title: Vertical航空獲AS9100品質認證 品質管理標準比肩空中巴士與波音
zh.summary: Vertical航空表示，英國標準協會已授予該公司AS9100認證，涵蓋設計與生產的品質管理系統；該公司認為自己是首家取得這項認證的eVTOL開發商，標準與空中巴士及波音採用的相同。
body: 電動垂直起降航空器（eVTOL）開發商Vertical航空11月12日表示，英國標準協會（BSI）已授予該公司AS9100認證，這是一項全球公認的航太品質標準。該公司表示，這項認證確認其設計與生產的品質管理系統符合空中巴士與波音等製造商採用的標準，也為潛在客戶提供獨立保證，涵蓋未來飛機生產與交付背後的流程、設施、供應商與團隊。
Vertical表示，該公司相信自己是首家取得AS9100認證的eVTOL開發商。執行長史都華·辛普森表示，取得AS9100代表其品質管理系統已通過與空中巴士、波音等老牌製造商相同標準的認證。該公司表示，認證是經過為期一年的計畫、強化全公司品質實務、最終接受BSI獨立評估後取得。AS9100由國際航太品質組織制定，以ISO9001為基礎，加入航空、太空與國防的專門要求。
這項認證之際，Vertical正為飛機計畫的下一階段做準備。2026年9月，該公司在其位於科茲窩機場的飛行測試中心啟用專屬飛機組裝中心，將提供產能製造符合認證要求的飛機，用於符合性展示與驗證測試，目標是在2029年取得型號認證。該中心也將用於改裝一架原型機，於2027年上半年進行混合動力飛行測試。
